title: How Do Mergers Affect the Mental Health of Employees?
eligible_reason: All main-text DiD tables (Tables 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10) and the event-study Figures 1-2 are estimated on a stacked panel (12_Create_Stacked.do builds one sub-experiment per merger_year with not-yet-treated workers as controls) with sample-specific fixed effects (sample##lopnr_SCB, sample##age, sample##sector##year), which the protocol excludes as a stacked design. The only non-stacked regressions in the main text are Table 5 (post_merger interacted with successful_merger, a subgroup-by-treatment interaction) and Figure 3 (event-time dummies with age and sector-by-year FE but no individual FE), and Figure 4 (raw means by event time). Every specification also includes age fixed effects and sector-by-year fixed effects, which are time-varying for workers (age changes each year; sector follows the current employer), so no column has the plain unit plus calendar-time FE structure. Data are Swedish registry microdata that cannot be shipped.
design_notes: Worker-year panel 2006-2015 (globals startYear/endYear) of employees of merging Swedish firms (targets and acquirers); event time et_merger = year - merger_year + 100, window -5..+7 (startDate 95, endDate 107). post_merger = et_merger >= 100. All workers in the panel belong to a merging firm (merger_year never missing), so there is no never-treated group; the stacked design uses not-yet-treated workers from other merger cohorts as controls (treatment_group = sample == merger_year). Outcomes: sumMentalHealth, Mental_illness, Depression, Anxiety, inpatient, outpatient, Psy_meds, Antidepressants, forddd. Clustering by treatment_cluster = group(merger_firm merger_year). The runRegression program (00_Programs.do) has a branch for FE 'absorb(sample##lopnr_SCB sample##year)' (individual + year FE only), but no table or figure do-file invokes it; the global feList is 'absorb(sample##age sample##lopnr_SCB sample##sector##year)'. Failed mergers serve as a comparison in Table 5 (successful_merger interaction). Table A6 is a cross-sectional wage regression; Table A7 is a dynamic AR regression.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Merger years 2006-2015 (up to 10 cohorts); exact count of cohorts with usable pre and post periods unknown without data.
modern_estimator_note: Stacked regression (Cengiz et al. 2019 style) is the paper's heterogeneity-robust approach; no CSA/SA/BJS/dCDH call in the code.

specs.exclusion_reason: stacked design; age FE and sector-by-year FE (time-varying)
specs.outcome: sumMentalHealth Mental_illness Depression Anxiety inpatient outpatient Psy_meds Antidepressants forddd (one column each)
specs.treatment_definition: post_merger = et_merger >= 100 within each stack; treatment_group = worker's merger_year equals the stack year
specs.sample_condition: successful mergers (failed_merger == 0), et_merger in [95, 107] after dropFailed shift
specs.notes: Tables 3, 6-10 reuse the same program with sample splits or triple interactions.

specs.exclusion_reason: subgroup-by-treatment interaction (post_merger x successful_merger); age FE and sector-by-year FE
specs.fe: sample##age sample##lopnr_SCB sample##sector##year (sample constant in non-stacked data)
specs.sample_condition: successful and (ledger-verified) failed mergers, et_merger in [95, 107]

specs.exclusion_reason: no individual FE (absorbs age and sector-by-year only); all units eventually treated
stacked design; age FE and sector-by-year FE
specs.treatment_definition: stack-specific event time interacted with treatment group; base t = -1

data_files_note: No data in the package. Readme.pdf: access requires a research proposal to Statistics Sweden and Swedish ethics approval; medical registries from Socialstyrelsen; Serrano firm data from Bisnode; military test data from Rekryteringsmyndigheten/Riksarkivet. Package contains do-files (00_ to 13_, tables/, figures/) and .smcl logs.
software_notes: Stata (reghdfe, outreg2, estout); Figure A3 drawn in LaTeX from csv exports.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Logs (logs/Table_2.smcl etc.) could be parsed for published coefficients if the paper is ever needed for comparison, but the design is not eligible as estimated. An individual + year FE non-stacked TWFE could be constructed from the panel (program branch exists), but it is not reported in any table or figure.
